summary: Elecebre's exclusive banner (Siren's Song Summon) is not worth pulling on, as she has been heavily powercrept and provides very little value in both PvE and PvP. Among the original pool of exclusive legendaries, Elecebre is considered the worst, whereas Reytah remains the undisputed number one. Players are strongly urged to save their summoning resources for the Anneliesis banner, which was announced for November on the Chinese server. Anneliesis is considered the absolute top-tier aura/support character in the entire game, offering massive team-wide damage amplification and crowd control across all content.

heroes.name: Elecebre
heroes.note: She has been heavily powercrept, bringing lackluster utility and negligible value to modern PvE and PvP team compositions.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: She is the most versatile aura support hero in the game, boosting damage, HP, and ultimate energy while providing exceptional control for any composition.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Remains the single best and most valuable exclusive hero from the original batch.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Praised for the unique mechanic of adapting elemental affinities to fit into any seasonal team setup.

meta_changes: Developers are developing a new battle game mode specifically aimed at making underutilized heroes viable again.
Anneliesis banner announced for November on the Chinese server, creating a high-priority summoning target for global players to plan ahead for.
tips: Completely skip the Siren's Song Summon banner featuring Elecebre.
Hoard all Heliolite dice to prepare for the upcoming Anneliesis banner.
